result:
Round 505 passes on product behaviour, with one Low finding that B still has to rule on. This was a Store `/support` chat round. It had no Studio audio, WAV export or video work, so I didn't measure any of that. `/studio-lab` got a smoke check only.

A stopped before handing over. The code-reviewer's Medium finding A-R505-CR-1 was never ruled on. The jsdom test B2D-7 never focuses "Start Chat" before the guest form closes, so it doesn't exercise the real flow. I confirmed this by reading the test. I rate it Low rather than Medium, because the real path is covered in the browser and mutants M6–M8 turn red. B should either defer it as Low or allow the one-line `.focus()` edit and re-issue the post-patch sha.

- **Browser:** `/support` ran at 1440×900, 1280×720 and 375×812. The output matched B's expected output (`sketch.out`) except timestamps, and differed from the HEAD output. After "Start Chat", focus lands on the message textarea (HEAD left it on the page body). Send is 40×40 with a 12 px radius and a 20 px icon.
- **Focus edge cases:** if focus moves elsewhere while the session starts, it stays there. A keyboard send keeps focus on the field with the focus ring visible.
- **Tests and checks:**
  - The six covering test files pass (80/80).
  - Mutants M1–M15 are all red on their expected rows.
  - The scanner reads 94 hits / 33 solid.
  - Frozen-file checks 2 and 4 pass.
  - The claims script reports 0 MISSING.
- **Auth:** in a fresh no-credential context, `/studio/1` and `/account/downloads` show "Sign in required" with no download link. `/studio-lab` opens the demo at both viewports, so premium auth is not bypassed.
- **Blocked:** the real chat backend, SignalR and admin replies ("backend unavailable in cloud"). The chat rows after "Start Chat" are stubbed, so they cover the client path only.
- **Not checked:**
  - I didn't re-measure the 2 px focus offset (the probe reads `solid 1px`, same as B's expected output).
  - I viewed only one screenshot, `studio-lab-1280.png`.
  - I only partly traced the docs.
  - The full test suite, build and `npm run verify` belong to the root gate.

`c-round-505.json` has `browserVerified` and `realVerified` set to true, the L57 check reports OK, and I made no changes to app source.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-505.md`
- `c-round-505.json`
- `c-round-505/`
